Create a DirectTargetMatch object

Source: R/Constructor_DirectargetMatch.R
createDirectTargetMatch.Rd

Constructor for the DirectTargetMatch S4 class. Validates inputs and provides sensible defaults before calling new().

Usage

createDirectTargetMatch(
  FT,
  Comp_data,
  PIon = "[M+H]+",
  diff_mz_thr = 0.005,
  ppm = 10,
  rt_thr_compound = 30
)

Arguments

FT

A data.frame of detected features. Must contain a feature_name column and an m/z column (mzmed, mz, or m/z). An RT column (rtmed or rt) is optional but enables RT gating when the target list also has RT values.

Comp_data

A data.frame target list. Accepted formats: HMDB (MONO_MASS, [M+H]+, [M-H]-), plate-based (Neutral mass, M+H, M-H, CNAME), PA14 (exactMass, [M+H]+, [M-H]-, RT), or any format supported by normalize_target_list().

PIon

Primary ion: "[M+H]+" (positive mode) or "[M-H]-" (negative mode). Default "[M+H]+".

diff_mz_thr

Numeric. Absolute m/z tolerance in Da. Default 0.005 (5 mDa).

ppm

Numeric. ppm m/z tolerance. Default 10.

rt_thr_compound

Numeric. RT window in seconds for feature vs compound RT gating. Default 30. Set to Inf to disable entirely.

Value

A DirectTargetMatch S4 object ready to pass to PImatch_target().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Works with any supported target list format
obj <- createDirectTargetMatch(
  FT              = xcms_output_ft,
  Comp_data       = plate_target_list,  # or PA14_target_list,  hmdb_target_list
  PIon            = "[M+H]+",
  diff_mz_thr     = 0.005,
  ppm             = 10,
  rt_thr_compound = 30
)
obj <- PImatch_target(obj)
df  <- flatten(obj)
} # }
